import json
from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=inp[i][j]
            if c==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            # BFS component
            comp=[]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and inp[ny][nx]!=bg and inp[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[y for y,_ in comp]; xs=[x for _,x in comp]
            cy,cx=min(ys),min(xs); ch=max(ys)-cy+1; cw=max(xs)-cx+1
            col=c
            for y in range(cy,cy+ch):
                for x in range(cx,cx+cw):
                    out[y][x]=col
            for y,x in comp: pass
    return out
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(f(I)==O)
T=G['Test input']
for r in f(T): print(r)
